answer.rationale: Broadly roll out the confirmed shortened/simplified onboarding path for SMB self-serve accounts. It improves completion, reduces time-to-value, and has evidence of a positive 30-day retention effect, supporting sustainable qualified revenue under competitive pressure. Do not answer the competitor's cut with promotional pricing: recovered source exp_73 showed acquisition and qualified-revenue gains but a 12% 30-day retention decline, creating material downstream value risk. The exact revenue magnitude of an onboarding rollout in this price-shock context remains uncertain, but its demonstrated retention-positive direction makes it the strongest durable option available today.
